active_time_definition: scheduling window from first motion through final directional stroke. Final 1.6 seconds excluded from the denominator; actual reversals in the tail still count.

policy.objective: Maximize signed forward mm/s divided by the square root of directional swings/s. Prefer a passing gait on both sides, then repeated braking on a loaded edge.
